The best ideas grow from trust, openness and shared ambition. We’re Kith&Kin, a Cardiff-based creative studio, and we create work that matters and build relationships that last. We’re in it together. We like to get close to the people and thinking behind every project. To understand what matters, challenge things when it helps and share in the decisions along the way. And when the work goes out into the world, we stay interested in where it takes you next. What we do About us Our work Kith&Kin is a new studio built on years of experience. The projects here represent the work that's shaped how we think and how we work. Some were created through Kith&Kin. Others were created in previous roles, long before the studio existed. Every project is clearly credited because being honest about where our work comes from matters. These projects are part of the journey that led to Kith&Kin, and we're proud to share them. We’re proud of the work that got us here, and even more excited about what comes next.
